name: Bailor's Ore Shipment
label: Quest
description: Bailor's Ore Shipment is a task undertaken by paladins seeking refined metal for Jordan Stilwell's sanctified weapon. The shipment of alloy was plundered…
intro: Bailor's Ore Shipment is a task undertaken by paladins seeking refined metal for Jordan Stilwell's sanctified weapon. The shipment of alloy was plundered by the Mo'grosh ogres during an ambush along the roadway from the Wetlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ach, ya startled me, friend! Can't ya see I was lost in thought?

What's that? Jordan's shipment... Fer Ironforge. Ahhh, yeah, I know whatcha speak of. Mo'grosh ogres... Dat's who took me ol' friend's ore shipment. Caravan was headin' here from the Wetlands and was ambushed. The guard who survived their attack just passed away a few days ago—healer couldn't get to 'em fast enough.
If you want the shipment, you'll have to head northeast across the Loch. It's got to be there somewhere.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So, any luck yet? Haha, those ogres didn't get the best of ya yet, did they?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yup yup, this is it. Ha! If I'd known you were really gonna head out there and fight some o' them ogres, I woulda given you a list of things to get instead of just this one thing. But, you're not here doin' business for me, are ya?.
A deal's a deal; Jordan wanted a shipment of me alloy, that's what he's gonna get.
Tell 'em hello fer me, and be safe, adventurer.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
